requirements.title: Program termination is normal or error termination
requirements.definition: Termination of execution is either normal or error termination, and program termination occurs after all images have terminated or failed.

pending.normal-termination-kind: Run a single-image main program that closes a file containing sentinel 122 and reaches END PROGRAM; driver checks normal completion and exact file content without asserting status value.
pending.error-termination-kind: Run a single-image main program that writes sentinel 123 before ERROR STOP; driver treats ERROR STOP termination as the expected lifecycle event without asserting diagnostic text.
pending.termination-after-all-images-terminated-: OUT OF SCOPE for multi-image completion and failed-image cases by user decision; single-image controls use the normal and error termination owners only.

requirements.title: Normal termination occurs through initiation, synchronization, and completion
requirements.definition: Normal termination occurs only after all images initiate normal termination and has initiation, synchronization, and completion steps.

pending.normal-initiation-step: Single-image END PROGRAM and STOP controls from S5.3.7-003 establish initiation; no multi-image synchronization oracle is asserted.
pending.normal-synchronization-step: OUT OF SCOPE: observing synchronization among images during normal termination requires multi-image execution excluded by user decision.
pending.normal-completion-step: Use a C atexit handler registered before Fortran STOP; normal completion is observed by exact handler side effect sentinel 124 under companion-processor controls.

requirements.title: STOP, END PROGRAM, and companion-processor procedures initiate normal termination
requirements.definition: Normal termination of an image is initiated by STOP or END PROGRAM, may also be initiated by a companion-processor procedure, and includes the effect of C exit() during completion for programs incorporating companion-processor procedures.

pending.stop-initiates-normal-termination: Run PROGRAM p that writes sentinel 125, closes the file, then executes STOP; driver checks normal completion and exact file content, not a universal status.
pending.end-program-initiates-normal-termination: Run PROGRAM p that writes sentinel 126, closes the file, and reaches END PROGRAM; driver checks normal completion and exact file content.
pending.companion-processor-normal-termination: Mixed C/Fortran source registers a C termination callback and calls a Fortran subroutine that returns sentinel 127 before C initiates normal termination.
pending.c-exit-effect-in-completion: Mixed C/Fortran source registers a C atexit handler that records sentinel 128; Fortran initiates normal termination and the driver checks the handler record.

requirements.title: Error termination starts with ERROR STOP or as specified elsewhere
requirements.source: 5.3.7 p1 and p3, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF60.
requirements.definition: Error termination occurs after any image initiates it; ERROR STOP initiates error termination, and other document locations can specify error termination.

pending.error-stop-initiates-error-termination: Run PROGRAM p that writes sentinel 129 then executes ERROR STOP; driver observes the expected error-termination lifecycle without asserting diagnostic wording.
pending.elsewhere-specified-error-termination: Source-control inventory links later rules that explicitly initiate error termination back to this facet; no standalone trigger is invented here.
pending.error-termination-propagates-to-other-im: OUT OF SCOPE: observing propagation to other images requires multi-image execution excluded by user decision.

requirements.title: Processors should propagate error termination quickly
requirements.definition: After error termination has been initiated on an image, the processor should initiate error termination on other images as quickly as possible.

pending.quick-error-propagation-recommendation: No portable oracle assigns a numeric deadline to the recommendation. Multi-image propagation timing is OUT OF SCOPE by user decision.

requirements.title: Non-ERROR-STOP error termination status is recommended nonzero under process-status support
requirements.definition: For processors supporting process exit status, it is recommended that error termination initiated other than by ERROR STOP supplies a processor-dependent nonzero status.

pending.process-status-support-premise: Guarded profile plan first records that the processor exposes process exit status; absent support leaves this facet unclaimed.
pending.processor-dependent-nonzero-status-recom: Trigger an elsewhere-specified non-ERROR-STOP error termination only after its owner is registered; accepted statuses are nonzero but the exact value is processor dependent.
